title: Hunts FH-043S: Team screens, scan hand-off and award wiring for Expedition teams

source.ref: Split from FH-043 (2026-11-16): the database rules, server layer and actions shipped dark behind HUNTS_CLAIMS_ENABLED; the player surfaces move here.

detail:
Owed after FH-043. (1) Web: the team panel on the Trail play page (form a team, show the invite code once, join with a code, lock the roster, leave, the team's progress) calling the actions in app/(main)/hunts/[slug]/play/team-actions.ts; needs a design look. (2) Web: the scan landing and POST at app/(main)/hunts/p/[code]/route.ts still credit only the caller's own run, so a team member who is not captain must type the code on the play page today; route a team member's scan through claimAsTeamMember. (3) Game systems: nothing calls hunt_team_award_allocate yet. hunt_reward_grant still grants a finished team run's reward to the captain; decide per reward whether the team holds one unit or a split, and call the allocation when the grant lands. (4) Database owner: apply migration 20270346082000_hunt_teams_editions.sql through the serialized gate and confirm supabase/tests/hunt_teams.test.sql passes in db-tests; check by hand with two sessions that two members claiming one stop queue on the team row lock. (5) Owner decision: whether teammates may see each other's display names (docs/hunts/ROLE-MATRIX.md has no roster view; the store returns a count only). Done when: a non-captain member scans a stop's code and the team run is credited once, and a signed-out visitor, an outsider and a departed member see no team data. Requires: FH-043, FH-016. Owner role: Web, with Identity and game systems.

Closed 2026-11-16 for what an agent can build, dark behind HUNTS_CLAIMS_ENABLED (rewards also behind HUNTS_REWARDS_ENABLED). (1) Team panel: components/hunts/team-panel.tsx on app/(main)/hunts/[slug]/play/page.tsx starts a team and shows the invite code and a team link once, joins from a shared team link plus the code, lets only the captain lock a forming roster, leaves, and shows the team's progress as a count. A member of a locked team plays the team run on that page (stops, hints, map and confirm form read the team run's credits through lib/hunts/team-store.ts myTeamView, and the typed code goes through claimTeamStopAction); a team member never opens a solo run there; a member of a forming team confirms nothing until the lock. (2) Scan hand-off: the scan landing app/(public)/play/[slug]/page.tsx gives a locked team member a confirm form carrying only team=1 (no solo token), and app/(main)/hunts/p/[code]/route.ts POST routes it through claimAsTeamMember with the same idempotency key the typed code uses (lib/hunts/teams.ts teamClaimKey), so a scan and a typed retry are one claim; an outsider or departed member lands on the same refusal, an unlocked roster reads its own line. (3) Award wiring: lib/hunts/team-store.ts grantTeamReward has the captain (the team run's subject) call hunt_reward_grant on the team run and, when the grant lands or replays and the policy is split, calls hunt_team_award_allocate once per team and reward; policy is a required argument (captain-held or split with units). Tests: route, landing, play page and team-store cover a non-captain scan crediting the team run once, the outsider, departed and signed-out cases, and the dark switches. Not done here, split to FH-043T: the design look on a real phone, the owner's per-reward hold-or-split choice and the reward screen that calls grantTeamReward, the roster-names decision, and applying the migration with the two-session lock check.
